record.title: Implement bounded bulk ADC input observation at the existing checkpoint
record.intent: Add capture-only observation of the complete reviewed ADC software inputs without advancing stock initialization.
requirements: Pin the reviewed static contract and implement a separate opt-in capture profile at the existing whole-group pre-SetADCParameter checkpoint 0x333ba8 after group convergence; preserve inherited register transcript and loader checkpoints.

Capture the complete ADC matrix and bucket state, existing main record, runtime setting and rate fields, series selectors and rows, selected config and normalized-mask mode entry, fifteen live shadows and their relocation bindings; capture diagnostic state or explicitly separate it from required operands.

Validate every object address and relocation before capture and every selected pointer before following it; use checked arithmetic, explicit pointer ranges, selected mask bounds, bounded capture sizes and fail-closed short reads. Do not read the modeled MMIO mapping as ordinary memory.

Preserve all-thread convergence, unchanged stock instructions and registers, synchronization behavior, no post-terminal resume, bounded cleanup and system_server health. Add no device response and execute no SetADCParameter instruction.

Implement deterministic positive and negative private fixtures and typed independent verification with explicit inherited-check coverage; freeze source and binary identity plus stock and control contracts before any guest run.

Add narrowly scoped copy-on-write staging for new disposable userdata files where supported and verify byte identity and independent inode ownership; preserve existing evidence and stock images and refuse a run with insufficient disk space.

Verify host-side decoding, pointer selection, signedness, missing or truncated captures and tampered evidence using independent regular copies. Commit and push the implementation and frozen input contracts before the private guest controls.
acceptance: A byte-pinned bounded capture profile with meaningful host controls is committed and pushed without guest execution.
